create_feature_map_processor: create a FeatureMapProcessor to select, concatenate, and rescale feature maps in a pose estimation model
run_forward_with_select_index: run the forward pass selecting specific feature map indices from a sequence of tensors
run_forward_with_concat: run the forward pass concatenating multiple feature maps along the channel dimension
run_forward_with_rescale: run the forward pass rescaling feature maps by a given scale factor using bilinear interpolation
run_forward_with_relu: run the forward pass applying ReLU activation to input feature maps before processing
